047/**
048 * Sends log events to an OTLP/HTTP endpoint ({@code /v1/logs}) as protobuf (the default)
049 * or JSON, without the OpenTelemetry SDK or a protobuf library.
050 * <p>
051 * Events are buffered and sent as one request per {@link #flush()}, and as soon as
052 * {@code maxBatchSize} events are pending. Use an asynchronous publisher: with the
053 * default synchronous one every log call waits for its own HTTP request. HTTP 429, 502,
054 * 503, and 504 responses and network errors are retried up to three times with
055 * exponential backoff with jitter, honoring {@code Retry-After}. The timeout bounds the
056 * whole export, including retries and response-body reads. A batch that still fails is
057 * dropped, recorded as an error alert, and counted in {@value #FAILED_METRIC}. Records
058 * the endpoint reports as rejected (partial success) are a warning alert and counted in
059 * {@value #REJECTED_METRIC}.
060 * <p>
061 * This output encodes events itself, so it does not use an appender encoder. Records have
062 * the same content as {@link OtlpJsonEncoder} produces.
063 */
064public final class OtlpOutput implements LogOutput, LogOutput.ProvidesEncoder {
065
066        /**
067         * Output URI scheme.
068         */
069        public static final String OTLP_SCHEME = "otlp";
070
071        /**
072         * Metric counting log records dropped because a request failed.
073         */
074        public static final String FAILED_METRIC = "otlp.records.failed";
075
076        /**
077         * Metric counting log records the endpoint rejected in a partial success response.
078         */
079        public static final String REJECTED_METRIC = "otlp.records.rejected";
080
081        /**
082         * Default maximum number of events per request.
083         */
084        public static final int DEFAULT_MAX_BATCH_SIZE = 512;
085
086        /**
087         * Default export timeout in milliseconds.
088         */
089        public static final int DEFAULT_TIMEOUT = 10_000;
090
091        static final int MAX_RETRIES = 3;
092
093        // Tests shorten this; production backoff is 1s, 2s, 4s.
094        static volatile long retryBaseMillis = 1000;
095
096        private static final Set<Integer> RETRYABLE = Set.of(429, 502, 503, 504);
097
098        private static final Pattern REJECTED_JSON = Pattern.compile("\"rejectedLogRecords\"\\s*:\\s*\"?(\\d+)");
099
100        private static final Pattern ERROR_JSON = Pattern.compile("\"errorMessage\"\\s*:\\s*\"((?:[^\"\\\\]|\\\\.)*)\"");
101
102        private static final LogEvent PLACEHOLDER = LogEvent.of(Instant.EPOCH, "", 0, Level.INFO, "", "", KeyValues.of(),
103                        null);

133        OtlpOutput(URI endpoint, OtlpProtocol protocol, Map<String, String> headers, boolean gzip, Duration timeout,
134                        int maxBatchSize, OtlpResource resource, String traceIdKey, String spanIdKey, LogConfig config) {
135                this.endpoint = endpoint;
136                this.displayEndpoint = LogProperty.redactUri(endpoint);
137                this.protocol = protocol;
138                this.headers = Map.copyOf(headers);
139                this.gzip = gzip;
140                this.timeout = timeout;
141                this.maxBatchSize = maxBatchSize;
142                this.resource = resource;
143                this.traceIdKey = traceIdKey;
144                this.spanIdKey = spanIdKey;
145                this.alerts = config.alerts();
146                this.metrics = config.metrics();
147                this.client = HttpClient.newBuilder().connectTimeout(timeout).build();
148        }

150        /**
151         * Creates the output with a builder lambda; properties are applied after the lambda.
152         * @param consumer configures the builder.
153         * @return output provider.
154         */
155        public static LogProvider<OtlpOutput> of(Consumer<OtlpOutputBuilder> consumer) {
156                return (name, config) -> {
157                        var b = new OtlpOutputBuilder(name);
158                        consumer.accept(b);
159                        return b.fromProperties(config.properties()).build().provide(name, config);
160                };
161        }
162
163        /**
164         * Creates the output. Any value not set falls back to the matching
165         * {@code OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_*} environment variable when environment variables are
166         * enabled, then to the OTLP default.
167         * @param name output name.
168         * @param endpoint full URL to post to, default {@code http://localhost:4318/v1/logs}.
169         * @param protocol {@code http/protobuf} (default) or {@code http/json}.
170         * @param headers extra request headers, for example authentication.
171         * @param compression {@code gzip} or {@code none} (default).
172         * @param timeout export timeout in milliseconds, including retries, default
173         * {@value OtlpOutput#DEFAULT_TIMEOUT}.
174         * @param maxBatchSize maximum events per request, default
175         * {@value OtlpOutput#DEFAULT_MAX_BATCH_SIZE}.
176         * @param serviceName {@code service.name} resource attribute, default
177         * {@code unknown_service:java}.
178         * @param resourceAttributes additional resource attributes.
179         * @param traceIdKey key value holding the trace id, default {@code traceId}.
180         * @param spanIdKey key value holding the span id, default {@code spanId}.
181         * @param environmentVariables whether the standard {@code OTEL_*} environment
182         * variables are read, default off.
183         * @return output provider.
184         */
185        @LogConfigurable(name = "OtlpOutputBuilder", prefix = LogProperties.OUTPUT_PREFIX + "otlp.")
186        static LogProvider<OtlpOutput> of(@LogConfigurable.KeyParameter String name, @Nullable URI endpoint,
187                        @ConvertParameter("parseProtocol") @Nullable OtlpProtocol protocol, @Nullable Map<String, String> headers,
188                        @Nullable String compression, @Nullable Integer timeout, @Nullable Integer maxBatchSize,
189                        @Nullable String serviceName, @Nullable Map<String, String> resourceAttributes, @Nullable String traceIdKey,
190                        @Nullable String spanIdKey,
191                        @ConvertParameter("parseEnvironmentVariables") @Nullable EnvironmentVariables environmentVariables) {
192                boolean env = environmentVariables == EnvironmentVariables.ON;
193                URI endpoint_ = endpoint;
194                if (endpoint_ == null) {
195                        var fromEnv = env ? OtlpEnvironment.logsEndpoint() : null;
196                        endpoint_ = URI.create(fromEnv != null ? fromEnv : OtlpEnvironment.DEFAULT_ENDPOINT);
197                }
198                OtlpProtocol protocol_ = protocol;
199                if (protocol_ == null) {
200                        var fromEnv = env ? OtlpEnvironment.logsValue("PROTOCOL") : null;
201                        protocol_ = fromEnv != null ? OtlpProtocol.parse(fromEnv) : OtlpProtocol.HTTP_PROTOBUF;
202                }
203                var headers_ = new LinkedHashMap<String, String>();
204                if (env) {
205                        headers_.putAll(OtlpEnvironment.headers());
206                }
207                if (headers != null) {
208                        headers_.putAll(headers);
209                }
210                String compression_ = compression != null ? compression : env ? OtlpEnvironment.logsValue("COMPRESSION") : null;
211                boolean gzip = parseCompression(compression_);
212                Integer timeout_ = timeout;
213                if (timeout_ == null) {
214                        var fromEnv = env ? OtlpEnvironment.logsValue("TIMEOUT") : null;
215                        timeout_ = fromEnv != null ? parsePositive("OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_TIMEOUT", fromEnv) : DEFAULT_TIMEOUT;
216                }
217                int maxBatchSize_ = maxBatchSize == null ? DEFAULT_MAX_BATCH_SIZE : maxBatchSize;
218                if (maxBatchSize_ <= 0) {
219                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("maxBatchSize must be positive: " + maxBatchSize_);
220                }
221                if (timeout_ <= 0) {
222                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("timeout must be positive: " + timeout_);
223                }
224                var resource = OtlpResource.of(serviceName, resourceAttributes,
225                                env ? EnvironmentVariables.ON : EnvironmentVariables.OFF);
226                URI e = endpoint_;
227                OtlpProtocol p = protocol_;
228                Duration t = Duration.ofMillis(timeout_);
229                String traceIdKey_ = traceIdKey == null ? OtlpJsonEncoder.DEFAULT_TRACE_ID_KEY : traceIdKey;
230                String spanIdKey_ = spanIdKey == null ? OtlpJsonEncoder.DEFAULT_SPAN_ID_KEY : spanIdKey;
231                return (n, config) -> new OtlpOutput(e, p, headers_, gzip, t, maxBatchSize_, resource, traceIdKey_, spanIdKey_,
232                                config);
233        }
234
235        static OtlpProtocol parseProtocol(String value) {
236                return OtlpProtocol.parse(value);
237        }
238
239        static EnvironmentVariables parseEnvironmentVariables(String value) {
240                return EnvironmentVariables.parse(value);
241        }
242
243        private static boolean parseCompression(@Nullable String value) {
244                if (value == null) {
245                        return false;
246                }
247                return switch (value.strip().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)) {
248                        case "gzip" -> true;
249                        case "none" -> false;
250                        default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException(
251                                        "Invalid OTLP compression: '" + value + "'. Expected one of: gzip, none.");
252                };
253        }
254
255        private static int parsePositive(String name, String value) {
256                try {
257                        return Integer.parseInt(value.strip());
258                }
259                catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
260                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid " + name + ": '" + value + "'. Expected milliseconds.", ex);
261                }
262        }

312        private void add(LogEvent event) {
313                pending.add(OtlpRecord.of(event, traceIdKey, spanIdKey));
314                if (pending.size() >= maxBatchSize) {
315                        send();
316                }
317        }
318
319        @Override
320        public void flush() {
321                send();
322        }
323
324        @Override
325        public void close() {
326                try {
327                        send();
328                }
329                finally {
330                        client.close();
331                }
332        }
333
334        private void send() {
335                if (pending.isEmpty()) {
336                        return;
337                }
338                /*
339                 * The async publisher interrupts its thread on shutdown and then drains the
340                 * remaining events on it. Clear the flag so those final batches are still sent
341                 * (as FileChannelOutput does, see LOGBACK-875), but skip retries so a down
342                 * endpoint cannot stall shutdown. The flag is restored afterwards.
343                 */
344                boolean interrupted = Thread.interrupted();
345                try {
346                        sendPending(interrupted ? 0 : MAX_RETRIES);
347                }
348                finally {
349                        if (interrupted) {
350                                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
351                        }
352                }
353        }
354
355        private void sendPending(int maxRetries) {
356                var records = List.copyOf(pending);
357                pending.clear();
358                int count = records.size();
359                long deadline = System.nanoTime() + timeout.toNanos();
360                HttpRequest request;
361                try {
362                        request = request(encode(records));
363                }
364                catch (RuntimeException ex) {
365                        requestFailed(count, ex);
366                        return;
367                }
368                for (int attempt = 0;; attempt++) {
369                        HttpResponse<byte[]> response;
370                        try {
371                                response = sendRequest(request, deadline);
372                        }
373                        catch (IOException | RuntimeException ex) {
374                                if (attempt < maxRetries && sleep(backoff(attempt), deadline)) {
375                                        continue;
376                                }
377                                requestFailed(count, ex);
378                                return;
379                        }
380                        int status = response.statusCode();
381                        if (status >= 200 && status < 300) {
382                                try {
383                                        partialSuccess(response.body(), count);
384                                }
385                                catch (IllegalArgumentException ex) {
386                                        // A successful HTTP response must not be retried after a decoding
387                                        // failure: the collector may already have accepted these records.
388                                        alerts.error(OtlpOutput.class, "Invalid OTLP response from " + displayEndpoint, ex);
389                                }
390                                return;
391                        }
392                        if (RETRYABLE.contains(status) && attempt < maxRetries && sleep(retryDelay(attempt, response), deadline)) {
393                                continue;
394                        }
395                        failed(count,
396                                        new IOException("HTTP " + status + " from " + displayEndpoint + ": " + preview(response.body())));
397                        return;
398                }
399        }
400
401        private HttpResponse<byte[]> sendRequest(HttpRequest request, long deadline) throws IOException {
402                long remaining = deadline - System.nanoTime();
403                if (remaining <= 0) {
404                        throw exportTimeout();
405                }
406                var future = client.sendAsync(request, HttpResponse.BodyHandlers.ofByteArray());
407                boolean interrupted = false;
408                try {
409                        while (true) {
410                                try {
411                                        return future.get(Math.max(0, deadline - System.nanoTime()), TimeUnit.NANOSECONDS);
412                                }
413                                catch (InterruptedException ex) {
414                                        // Preserve shutdown draining even if a publisher interrupts its
415                                        // worker.
416                                        // The deadline still bounds this wait; the flag prevents later
417                                        // retries.
418                                        interrupted = true;
419                                }
420                        }
421                }
422                catch (TimeoutException ex) {
423                        throw exportTimeout();
424                }
425                catch (ExecutionException ex) {
426                        var cause = ex.getCause();
427                        if (cause instanceof HttpTimeoutException) {
428                                throw exportTimeout();
429                        }
430                        if (cause instanceof IOException io) {
431                                throw io;
432                        }
433                        throw new IOException("OTLP request failed", cause);
434                }
435                finally {
436                        // HttpRequest.timeout does not cover the response body on Java 21.
437                        // Cancel the actual HTTP operation so close() cannot wait for it forever.
438                        if (!future.isDone()) {
439                                future.cancel(true);
440                        }
441                        if (interrupted) {
442                                Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
443                        }
444                }
445        }
446
447        private HttpTimeoutException exportTimeout() {
448                return new HttpTimeoutException("OTLP export timed out after " + timeout.toMillis() + " ms");
449        }
450
451        private void requestFailed(int count, Exception cause) {
452                if (!displayEndpoint.equals(endpoint.toString())) {
453                        // HTTP client exception messages and their causes may include credentials.
454                        // Keep the failure type and stack without retaining unsafe diagnostic text.
455                        var safe = new IOException(
456                                        "OTLP request failed (" + cause.getClass().getName() + "); endpoint credentials omitted");
457                        safe.setStackTrace(cause.getStackTrace());
458                        failed(count, safe);
459                }
460                else {
461                        failed(count, cause);
462                }
463        }
464
465        private byte[] encode(List<OtlpRecord> records) {
466                if (protocol == OtlpProtocol.HTTP_PROTOBUF) {
467                        return OtlpProtobuf.encode(resource, records);
468                }
469                var json = new JsonBuffer(false, ExtendedFieldPrefix.AT, -1);
470                OtlpJson.write(json, resource, records);
471                var capture = new ByteCapture();
472                json.drain(capture, PLACEHOLDER);
473                return capture.bytes.toByteArray();
474        }
475
476        private HttpRequest request(byte[] body) {
477                var builder = HttpRequest.newBuilder(endpoint).timeout(timeout).header("Content-Type", protocol.contentType());
478                headers.forEach(builder::header);
479                if (gzip) {
480                        body = gzip(body);
481                        builder.header("Content-Encoding", "gzip");
482                }
483                return builder.POST(HttpRequest.BodyPublishers.ofByteArray(body)).build();
484        }
485
486        private static byte[] gzip(byte[] body) {
487                var out = new ByteArrayOutputStream(body.length / 2 + 16);
488                try (var gz = new GZIPOutputStream(out)) {
489                        gz.write(body);
490                }
491                catch (IOException ex) {
492                        throw new UncheckedIOException(ex);
493                }
494                return out.toByteArray();
495        }
496
497        private static long backoff(int attempt) {
498                return backoff(attempt, ThreadLocalRandom.current().nextDouble());
499        }
500
501        static long backoff(int attempt, double random) {
502                long cap = retryBaseMillis << attempt;
503                // Equal jitter keeps a minimum delay while spreading clients across the
504                // upper half of the exponentially increasing interval.
505                return cap / 2 + (long) ((cap - cap / 2) * random);
506        }
507
508        private static long retryDelay(int attempt, HttpResponse<?> response) {
509                var retryAfter = response.headers().firstValue("Retry-After");
510                if (retryAfter.isPresent()) {
511                        try {
512                                return Math.min(Math.max(0, Long.parseLong(retryAfter.get().strip())), 30) * 1000;
513                        }
514                        catch (NumberFormatException ex) {
515                                // HTTP date form is not supported; fall back to exponential backoff.
516                        }
517                }
518                return backoff(attempt);
519        }
520
521        private static boolean sleep(long millis, long deadline) {
522                if (TimeUnit.MILLISECONDS.toNanos(millis) >= deadline - System.nanoTime()) {
523                        return false;
524                }
525                try {
526                        Thread.sleep(millis);
527                        return true;
528                }
529                catch (InterruptedException ex) {
530                        Thread.currentThread().interrupt();
531                        return false;
532                }
533        }
534
535        private void failed(int count, Exception cause) {
536                metrics.errorCounter(FAILED_METRIC, count);
537                alerts.error(OtlpOutput.class,
538                                "OTLP export to " + displayEndpoint + " failed; dropped " + count + " log records", cause);
539        }
540
541        private void partialSuccess(byte[] body, int count) {
542                if (body.length == 0) {
543                        return;
544                }
545                long rejected;
546                String message;
547                if (protocol == OtlpProtocol.HTTP_PROTOBUF) {
548                        var decoded = PartialSuccess.decode(body);
549                        rejected = decoded.rejected();
550                        message = decoded.message();
551                }
552                else {
553                        var text = new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
554                        var r = REJECTED_JSON.matcher(text);
555                        rejected = r.find() ? Long.parseLong(Objects.requireNonNullElse(r.group(1), "0")) : 0;
556                        var m = ERROR_JSON.matcher(text);
557                        message = m.find() ? Objects.requireNonNullElse(m.group(1), "") : "";
558                }
559                if (rejected > 0) {
560                        metrics.warnCounter(REJECTED_METRIC, rejected);
561                }
562                String detail = message.isEmpty() ? "" : ": " + message;
563                if (rejected > 0) {
564                        alerts.warn(OtlpOutput.class, "OTLP endpoint " + displayEndpoint + " rejected " + rejected + " of " + count
565                                        + " log records" + detail);
566                }
567                else if (!message.isEmpty()) {
568                        // A partial success with nothing rejected is a warning about accepted
569                        // records.
570                        alerts.warn(OtlpOutput.class,
571                                        "OTLP endpoint " + displayEndpoint + " returned a warning for " + count + " log records" + detail);
572                }
573        }
574
575        private static String preview(byte[] body) {
576                var s = new String(body, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
577                return s.length() > 200 ? s.substring(0, 200) + "..." : s;
578        }
579
580        /*
581         * Decodes ExportLogsServiceResponse.partial_success (field 1) holding
582         * rejected_log_records (1, varint) and error_message (2, string). Unknown fields are
583         * skipped.
584         */
585        record PartialSuccess(long rejected, String message) {
586
587                static PartialSuccess decode(byte[] body) {
588                        var outer = new ProtoReader(body, 0, body.length);
589                        long rejected = 0;
590                        String message = "";
591                        while (outer.hasMore()) {
592                                int tag = (int) outer.varint();
593                                if (tag >>> 3 == 1 && (tag & 7) == 2) {
594                                        var inner = outer.message();
595                                        while (inner.hasMore()) {
596                                                int t = (int) inner.varint();
597                                                if (t >>> 3 == 1 && (t & 7) == 0) {
598                                                        rejected = inner.varint();
599                                                }
600                                                else if (t >>> 3 == 2 && (t & 7) == 2) {
601                                                        var text = inner.message();
602                                                        message = new String(body, text.pos, text.end - text.pos, StandardCharsets.UTF_8);
603                                                }
604                                                else {
605                                                        inner.skip(t & 7);
606                                                }
607                                        }
608                                }
609                                else {
610                                        outer.skip(tag & 7);
611                                }
612                        }
613                        return new PartialSuccess(rejected, message);
614                }
615
616        }
617
618        private static final class ProtoReader {
619
620                private final byte[] buf;
621
622                int pos;
623
624                private final int end;
625
626                ProtoReader(byte[] buf, int pos, int end) {
627                        this.buf = buf;
628                        this.pos = pos;
629                        this.end = end;
630                }
631
632                boolean hasMore() {
633                        return pos < end;
634                }
635
636                long varint() {
637                        long result = 0;
638                        for (int shift = 0; shift < 64; shift += 7) {
639                                if (pos >= end) {
640                                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Truncated protobuf varint");
641                                }
642                                byte b = buf[pos++];
643                                if (shift == 63 && (b & 0xFE) != 0) {
644                                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Malformed protobuf varint");
645                                }
646                                result |= (long) (b & 0x7F) << shift;
647                                if ((b & 0x80) == 0) {
648                                        return result;
649                                }
650                        }
651                        throw new IllegalArgumentException("Malformed protobuf varint");
652                }
653
654                ProtoReader message() {
655                        int length = length();
656                        var message = new ProtoReader(buf, pos, pos + length);
657                        pos += length;
658                        return message;
659                }
660
661                private int length() {
662                        long length = varint();
663                        if (length < 0 || length > end - pos) {
664                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Invalid protobuf field length");
665                        }
666                        return (int) length;
667                }
668
669                private void advance(int length) {
670                        if (length > end - pos) {
671                                throw new IllegalArgumentException("Truncated protobuf field");
672                        }
673                        pos += length;
674                }
675
676                void skip(int wireType) {
677                        switch (wireType) {
678                                case 0 -> varint();
679                                case 1 -> advance(8);
680                                case 2 -> {
681                                        int length = length();
682                                        advance(length);
683                                }
684                                case 5 -> advance(4);
685                                default -> throw new IllegalArgumentException("Unsupported protobuf wire type: " + wireType);
686                        }
687                }
688
689        }
690
691        private static final class ByteCapture implements LogOutput {
692
693                final ByteArrayOutputStream bytes = new ByteArrayOutputStream();
694
695                @Override
696                public URI uri() {
697                        return URI.create("memory:///");
698                }
699
700                @Override
701                public void write(LogEvent event, byte[] b, int off, int len, ContentType contentType) {
702                        bytes.write(b, off, len);
703                }
704
705                @Override
706                public void flush() {
707                }
708
709                @Override
710                public OutputType type() {
711                        return OutputType.MEMORY;
712                }
713
714                @Override
715                public void close() {
716                }
717
718        }
719
720        /*
721         * The output encodes whole batches itself, so the appender encoder only has to hand
722         * each event through.
723         */
724        private static final class PassThroughEncoder implements LogEncoder {
725
726                static final PassThroughEncoder INSTANCE = new PassThroughEncoder();
727
728                private static final byte[] EMPTY = new byte[0];
729
730                @Override
731                public Buffer buffer(BufferHints hints) {
732                        return new Buffer() {
733                                @Override
734                                public void drain(LogOutput output, LogEvent event) {
735                                        output.write(event, EMPTY, 0, 0, ContentType.StandardContentType.APPLICATION_JSON);
736                                }
737
738                                @Override
739                                public void clear() {
740                                }
741                        };
742                }
743
744                @Override
745                public void encode(LogEvent event, Buffer buffer) {
746                }
747
748        }
749
750}
